sources.title: Articles on Smashing Magazine — For Web Designers And Developers

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Victor Yocco)
articles.description: Developing effective agentic AI requires a new research playbook. When systems plan, decide, and act on our behalf, UX moves beyond usability testing into the realm of trust, consent, and accountability. Victor Yocco outlines the research methods needed to design agentic AI systems responsibly.
articles.title: Beyond Generative: The Rise Of Agentic AI And User-Centric Design

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Amit Sheen)
articles.description: Amit Sheen takes a hard look at the “Pixel Perfect” legacy concept, explaining why it’s failing us and redefining what “perfection” actually looks like in a multi-device, fluid world.
articles.title: Rethinking “Pixel Perfect” Web Design

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Andy Clarke)
articles.description: CSS relative colour values are now widely supported. In this article, pioneering author and web designer [Andy Clarke](https://stuffandnonsense.co.uk/) shares practical techniques for using them to theme and animate SVG graphics.
articles.title: Smashing Animations Part 8: Theming Animations Using CSS Relative Colour

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: How to shape your career path for 2026, with decision trees for designers and a UX skills self-assessment matrix. The only limits for tomorrow are the doubts we have today. Brought to you by Smart Interface Design Patterns, a **friendly video course on UX** and design patterns by Vitaly.
articles.title: UX And Product Designer’s Career Paths In 2026

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Daniel Schwarz)
articles.description: [Penpot](https://penpot.app/?utm_source=SmashingMagazine&utm_medium=Article&utm_campaign=MCPserver) is experimenting with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, which could lead to designers and developers being able to perform tasks in Penpot using AI that’s able to understand and interact with Penpot design files. Daniel Schwarz explains how [Penpot MCP](https://github.com/penpot/penpot-mcp) servers work, what they could mean for creating and managing designs in Penpot, and what you can do to help shape their development.
articles.title: Penpot Is Experimenting With MCP Servers For AI-Powered Design Workflows

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Joas Pambou)
articles.description: Most developers spend their days fixing bugs, shipping features, and jumping into the next sprint without even thinking about it. After a while, you begin to ask yourself, “Is this still what I want to be doing?” This article looks at how you can move into a new direction in your career without starting from scratch, and how the skills you already use, like problem-solving, communication, and empathy, can open new doors.
articles.title: Pivoting Your Career Without Starting From Scratch

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: Whether 2026 has already begun as you’re reading this or you’re still waiting for the big countdown to start, how about some new wallpapers to get your desktop ready for the new year? We’ve got you covered.
articles.title: Countdown To New Adventures (January 2026 Wallpapers Edition)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: Practical UX guidelines to keep in mind for 466 million people who experience hearing loss. More design patterns in Smart Interface Design Patterns, a **friendly video course on UX** and design patterns by Vitaly.
articles.title: How To Design For (And With) Deaf People
